0d1c39bdceb92480016ec5838272105b88abc680.source: 选源与目标，检查并应用 F0，制作三类双向连续统，按端点/中间步/整组试听并保存完整结果。
0d1c39bdceb92480016ec5838272105b88abc680.translation: Select source and target, inspect and apply F0, create three types of bidirectional continua, listen to endpoints, intermediate steps, and complete sets, and save complete results.

03a73eb382178a6738126f58bb1627e95a2d9dba.source: 视频教程：<s id="0">观看本章视频</s>。
03a73eb382178a6738126f58bb1627e95a2d9dba.translation: Video tutorial: <s id="0">watch this chapter's video</s>.

fe074aa25fac0080c26827881871835764851e43.source: 选择源音频与目标音频

40f6e74c0093ff40ee0c87cc9c8e698f649e2ba1.source: 准备两份短 WAV，就可以逐级改变 F0、发声类型，或同时改变两者。每组以当前方向源音频的时长和声道滤波特性为基础，适合制作经过检查和预测试的实验刺激。先从一组九步结果开始，熟悉后再生成全部六组。
40f6e74c0093ff40ee0c87cc9c8e698f649e2ba1.translation: With two short WAVs, progressively change F0, phonation type, or both. Each set uses the duration and vocal-tract filtering characteristics of the source in the current direction, suitable for experimental stimuli after inspection and pilot testing. Begin with one nine-step set before generating all six sets.

f5e95e9d5e1b7c2e2f83c4e91796adbd571f2e57.source: 尽量选择内容相近、有声部分清楚的材料，先核对音节、发音者与录音质量。两份录音不必等长，但这些差异会影响比较。每份须同时满足 <s id="0">10 秒、480000 帧、8000000 字节</s>，原采样率允许 1000–192000 Hz。例如 10 秒、96000 Hz 已超过帧数限制，需先另存短片段。
f5e95e9d5e1b7c2e2f83c4e91796adbd571f2e57.translation: Prefer similar content with clear voiced portions; check syllables, speakers, and recording quality first. Recordings need not be equally long, but such differences affect comparisons. Each must satisfy <s id="0">10 seconds, 480000 frames, and 8000000 bytes</s> simultaneously; original sample rates can be 1000–192000 Hz. For example, 10 seconds at 96000 Hz exceeds the frame limit; save a short segment first.

06437d089e4806fa4597e4a472da3480124ce518.source: <s id="0">波形选区只用于试听，不会裁剪分析输入。</s> 需要只分析一段时，请先在音频编辑工具中另存该段。分析统一使用 11025 Hz。
06437d089e4806fa4597e4a472da3480124ce518.translation: <s id="0">Waveform selection is for listening only and does not trim analysis input.</s> To analyze only a segment, save it separately in an audio editor first. All analysis uses 11025 Hz.

54504cc4ace7714f2a31422ae4ccfb5a0753bdd6.source: 打开目录并试听两份材料
54504cc4ace7714f2a31422ae4ccfb5a0753bdd6.translation: Open a directory and listen to both materials

0406e2e84de58ad5adb6bf3af6d777ee2a70d4b8.source: 点击顶部 <s id="0">打开音频目录</s>，选择包含两份 WAV 的目录。文件刚加入或改写时，点击 <s id="1">刷新文件</s>。
0406e2e84de58ad5adb6bf3af6d777ee2a70d4b8.translation: Click <s id="0">Open audio directory</s> at the top and choose the directory containing both WAVs. Click <s id="1">Refresh files</s> after adding or modifying files.

a29879d0ccde43566b574023e15a64228b2284cf.source: 在左栏 <s id="0">源音频</s> 和 <s id="1">目标音频</s> 中分别选择文件，等待中栏出现两幅实际波形。
a29879d0ccde43566b574023e15a64228b2284cf.translation: Select files separately under <s id="0">Source audio</s> and <s id="1">Target audio</s> on the left, and wait for both actual waveforms in the center.

cf2a078ac8ca1b34868d911c2803228851e3a13c.source: 在波形上拖出选区，再用图下播放条试听。播放另一份音频时，前一份会停止。空格用于当前活动音频的播放控制。
cf2a078ac8ca1b34868d911c2803228851e3a13c.translation: Drag a waveform selection and listen using its playback bar. Playing the other audio stops the first. Space controls the currently active audio.

3d772454cb9812471ed86d5763c9a22876cb4f49.source: 源与目标 WAV 已载入，两幅原文件波形可见；F0 曲线、控制表与合成结果尚未建立。
3d772454cb9812471ed86d5763c9a22876cb4f49.translation: Source and target WAVs loaded with both original waveforms visible; F0 curves, control table, and synthesis results are not yet established.

6f843ae8e2d0aa21dd5edd3f245d9dd7b683dc55.source: 发声类型合成载入两份 WAV 后的最大化工作台，源和目标波形可见，F0 和合成图为空。
6f843ae8e2d0aa21dd5edd3f245d9dd7b683dc55.translation: Maximized phonation-synthesis workbench after loading two WAVs, with source/target waveforms visible and F0/synthesis plots empty.

a07590425981b3cda2be43a1b70149483e127f87.source: 本章两份原音如下。先听清各自的音高走向与边界，后面的例音始终使用这同一对材料。播放器使用 MP3 试听副本，正式测量请使用保存的 WAV。
a07590425981b3cda2be43a1b70149483e127f87.translation: The two original recordings used in this chapter follow. Listen to their pitch contours and boundaries first; all later examples use this same pair. Players use MP3 listening copies; use saved WAVs for formal measurements.

e91e483a665bfe33929129cb40ae6b12045b1fb3.source: 原始源音频：后续正向连续统的时长与声道基础。
e91e483a665bfe33929129cb40ae6b12045b1fb3.translation: Original source audio: duration and vocal-tract basis of subsequent forward continua.

563a4ef8b549e234962ea1ab8b26fc1a37770281.source: 原始目标音频：后续仅 F0 变化示例的另一端控制来源。
563a4ef8b549e234962ea1ab8b26fc1a37770281.translation: Original target audio: the other endpoint's control source in the later F0-only example.

3e75e3c378e5677e6a8e1c2078b136dd3da1fe1c.source: 网页使用当前项目中的 WAV，有添加入口时点击 <s id="0">添加 WAV</s>。输入和结果按项目权限、额度与有效期管理。合成控制 F0 的查看请使用桌面工作台。
3e75e3c378e5677e6a8e1c2078b136dd3da1fe1c.translation: The web uses WAVs in the current project; click <s id="0">Add WAV</s> when available. Inputs and results follow project permissions, quotas, and expiration. Use the desktop workbench to inspect synthesis-control F0.

c47c7d3c3b7a6f58c77e620b2133f6c07f608829.source: <s id="0">顶部</s>：打开/刷新文件、输出位置、保存参数草稿、帮助与方法与引用。
c47c7d3c3b7a6f58c77e620b2133f6c07f608829.translation: <s id="0">Top</s>: open/refresh files, output location, Save parameter draft, Help, and Methods and references.

ea528e5fc528d4d5a0ff26e6c6508c5adcc44431.source: <s id="0">左栏</s>：选材料，提取 F0，调整对齐与点数，编辑数值并应用。较长的控制表在栏内滚动。
ea528e5fc528d4d5a0ff26e6c6508c5adcc44431.translation: <s id="0">Left</s>: select materials, extract F0, set alignment and point count, edit values, and apply. Scroll within the panel for long control tables.

2ac2af0ab503e3aaa5d25c855e93eaf46c171005.source: <s id="0">中栏</s>：源、目标、F0、合成四图按 2×2 排列。源、目标、合成各有播放条；窄窗可滚动查看。
2ac2af0ab503e3aaa5d25c855e93eaf46c171005.translation: <s id="0">Center</s>: source, target, F0, and synthesis plots in a 2×2 layout. Source, target, and synthesis each have playback bars. Scroll in narrow windows.

2fd007eb59543ca84b8cb2b1d07b35dcf15be7c5.source: <s id="0">右栏</s>：设置连续统，查看任务进度，选择历史组并试听、保存。
2fd007eb59543ca84b8cb2b1d07b35dcf15be7c5.translation: <s id="0">Right</s>: configure continua, inspect progress, choose historical sets, listen, and save.

60ac59a9dc42677382c44b1753c740520cdcb9c3.source: <s id="0">底栏</s>：论文、原始仓库、复制引用、改写说明。复制失败时可选中引用文字手动复制。
60ac59a9dc42677382c44b1753c740520cdcb9c3.translation: <s id="0">Bottom</s>: paper, original repository, Copy citation, and adaptation notes. If copying fails, select citation text and copy manually.

70955f4cd6510067b414ec0b80156aca1d27e29d.source: 两份波形都载入后，在左栏核对分析参数，点击 <s id="0">提取 F0</s>。选择文件后需要手动执行这一步。完成时会出现源/目标控制曲线和数值表，合成图此时仍为空。
70955f4cd6510067b414ec0b80156aca1d27e29d.translation: After both waveforms load, inspect analysis parameters on the left and click <s id="0">Extract F0</s>. This must be performed manually after file selection. On completion, source/target control curves and a value table appear; the synthesis plot remains empty.

b7bc75236fdcfac8fbfa02dacd608b01b5aa006f.source: 常用 F0 分析设置

58bd6944e14736b0fdb3c8fd2e34ea83c6eb032c.source: 可切换 REAPER；切换后重新提取。
58bd6944e14736b0fdb3c8fd2e34ea83c6eb032c.translation: Can switch to REAPER; extract again afterward.

60ba7daeebf153fdf0645d339629b04d4806dc34.source: 按材料设定。最低允许 20–500，最高 50–1000，最低须小于最高。
60ba7daeebf153fdf0645d339629b04d4806dc34.translation: Set for the material. Minimum allows 20–500, maximum 50–1000; minimum must be lower.

dcb8c0338f2b9b5d31bda9d8c92ec799aaea08b7.source: 允许 0.5–20；表示提取间隔。保存轨迹统一为 1 ms。
dcb8c0338f2b9b5d31bda9d8c92ec799aaea08b7.translation: Allows 0.5–20, indicating extraction interval. Saved tracks uniformly use 1 ms.

fb0b889f1155898f3d2a3c3170ee19394634dd68.source: 嘎裂声或 F0 不规则材料可以比较 <s id="0">REAPER</s> 的结果。它是本工具新增的提取选项，结合波形和听感检查提取效果。提取方法由当前选择确定，更换方法后需重新分析。
fb0b889f1155898f3d2a3c3170ee19394634dd68.translation: For creaky voice or irregular F0, compare <s id="0">REAPER</s>. This added extraction option should be checked against waveforms and listening. The current selection determines the method; reanalyze after switching.

9ab6e3794d5e818d88250f5f29b31955978bd8fc.source: 提取 F0 完成后，左栏出现 21 点控制表，图中出现源实线与目标虚线；合成音频仍为空。本例最高 F0 为 600 Hz。
9ab6e3794d5e818d88250f5f29b31955978bd8fc.translation: After F0 extraction, a 21-point control table appears on the left, with solid source and dashed target curves. Synthesized audio remains empty. This example uses maximum F0 600 Hz.

671240393b27b9af9ad1c4bb84dc9b398e6d94e8.source: 分析完成的最大化工作台，归一化有声时长的 21 点表及源和目标 F0 曲线可见，未生成结果。
671240393b27b9af9ad1c4bb84dc9b398e6d94e8.translation: Maximized analyzed workbench with a 21-point normalized-voiced-duration table and source/target F0 curves, before result generation.

0080884d0c23a7cb7dc36be3b0e0dcc10241faeb.source: 本章例音和结果图使用 <s id="0">50–600 Hz</s>，初始上限仍为 300 Hz。先查看曲线是否有明显倍频、半频或尖跳，再决定是否编辑。
0080884d0c23a7cb7dc36be3b0e0dcc10241faeb.translation: This chapter's examples and figures use <s id="0">50–600 Hz</s>; the initial maximum remains 300 Hz. Check obvious doubling, halving, or spikes before deciding whether to edit.

e9ce2bb420f4070f2990b105cffafddfb721efb6.source: 必要时调整高级分析参数
e9ce2bb420f4070f2990b105cffafddfb721efb6.translation: Adjust advanced analysis parameters if needed

762ae5fbd3ddf610a49361987e03b07069abb810.source: 点击 <s id="0">高级分析参数</s> 展开。初次可保留默认值，遇到分析问题再逐项改变并记录。<s id="1">更换材料或修改任一分析参数后，都要重新提取 F0。</s>
762ae5fbd3ddf610a49361987e03b07069abb810.translation: Expand <s id="0">Advanced analysis parameters</s>. Keep defaults initially; change and record items individually when problems occur. <s id="1">Reextract F0 after changing materials or any analysis parameter.</s>

a11040e47e2f0f245a0d8bcdac63d0926ea38796.source: 展开高级分析参数后，可以逐项核对 LPC 帧长、帧移、阶数、窗函数与残差脉冲设置；图中各项使用初始默认值。
a11040e47e2f0f245a0d8bcdac63d0926ea38796.translation: Advanced parameters expanded for checking LPC frame length, shift, order, window, and residual-pulse settings individually. All shown use initial defaults.

a16cbd816c458392b9f0be211712de071bf99b47.source: 最大化工作台左栏展开高级分析参数，显示 128 点帧长、32 点帧移、20 阶 LPC 和其余默认参数。
a16cbd816c458392b9f0be211712de071bf99b47.translation: Maximized workbench with advanced analysis expanded on the left, showing frame length 128 samples, shift 32 samples, LPC order 20, and other defaults.

31e39ca26a2b0870cfb298325b1f3d4ab48fb185.source: 高级参数的默认值与主要约束

f5939ac974ae432496b282f3244f88ca7b8579ee.source: 帧长 / 帧移 (采样点)、LPC 阶数

790698ce0aa6c01cb97efa2d1a276e01b6b95faa.source: 范围分别为 32–1024、8–512、4–60；帧移和阶数须小于帧长。采样点以 11025 Hz 计。
790698ce0aa6c01cb97efa2d1a276e01b6b95faa.translation: Ranges respectively 32–1024, 8–512, and 4–60. Shift and order must be below frame length. Samples refer to 11025 Hz.

28cfd7564e0ffefac5744d9c497cb7c403ce331b.source: 预加重 0≤值<1；窗函数另有 hann、blackman、rectangular。
28cfd7564e0ffefac5744d9c497cb7c403ce331b.translation: Pre-emphasis 0≤value<1; alternative windows are hann, blackman, and rectangular.

e383097ee88aee48170f0ef596a5895d124d9d74.source: 允许 −0.2–0，影响残差脉冲检测。

90727b4864efc42fd6d806ccfac67436aa899120.source: 脉冲内窗 / 外窗 (周期)

f918da0dde8143be2ca8e6667ed8631f5dcb0935.source: 阈值允许 −80 至 −10；裁剪会改变分析信号长度，原波形仍显示原 WAV。
f918da0dde8143be2ca8e6667ed8631f5dcb0935.translation: Threshold −80 to −10. Trimming changes analysis-signal length; original waveforms still show original WAVs.

2c04a2c168aa303f0991da4c36f9f3de1d4563ff.source: 静音 padding / 有声边界余量 (ms)

e569cf86739021726db2583044b0cf45089d7d0b.source: 分别允许 0–80 / 0–120；调整后检查较弱起声和末尾。
e569cf86739021726db2583044b0cf45089d7d0b.translation: Allow 0–80 / 0–120 respectively. Check weak onsets and endings after adjustment.

173ccf4982f17e17b90357ee78ee1a524cdc7300.source: 这些范围表示软件可接受的输入，具体组合还要结合材料判断。帧长、帧移与 F0 帧间隔的单位不同，填写时看清括号即可。
173ccf4982f17e17b90357ee78ee1a524cdc7300.translation: These ranges indicate accepted software inputs; judge combinations against the material. Frame length, shift, and F0 frame interval have different units; check the parentheses.

6bc21c3049a6b888f13102ab1cf84c4560e41dd1.source: 编辑 F0 与查看曲线

3697d725ae95ea19502b1dce4f759e2e1c9b6269.translation: Set alignment and point count first

c5573cd0cfab12ff8e8928f40ad931ed10947f6c.source: <s id="0">归一化有声时长</s> 将两轨各自的有声部分映射到 0–100%。<s id="1">起点对齐</s> 从各自有声起点计毫秒，保留长短差异，较短轨末尾可能为空白。两种对齐都不会改变 WAV 时长。
c5573cd0cfab12ff8e8928f40ad931ed10947f6c.translation: <s id="0">Normalized voiced duration</s> maps each track's voiced portion to 0–100%. <s id="1">Onset alignment</s> measures milliseconds from each voiced onset, retaining length differences; the shorter track may end in blanks. Neither changes WAV duration.

3ddddc5c8ec1be47fd74f407d748545b183c39f3.source: <s id="0">F0 控制点数量</s> 初始为 21，允许 20–200。先定好对齐与点数，再编辑数值。改变任一设置会重建表格，尚未应用的手工值可能被替换。
3ddddc5c8ec1be47fd74f407d748545b183c39f3.translation: <s id="0">F0 control-point count</s> starts at 21, allowing 20–200. Set alignment and count before editing. Changing either rebuilds the table and may replace unapplied manual values.

47bc537f3c60c08892eac37ba5c0d7531d4fa132.source: 在 <s id="0">源 F0 (Hz)</s> 或 <s id="1">目标 F0 (Hz)</s> 列输入数值。允许 0–1000，每轨至少保留一个正值，时间列不可编辑。
47bc537f3c60c08892eac37ba5c0d7531d4fa132.translation: Enter values in <s id="0">Source F0 (Hz)</s> or <s id="1">Target F0 (Hz)</s>. Allowed range is 0–1000, with at least one positive value per track. Time columns are read-only.

3be922f8707c84b5ad65048c8905171eb13bcd5b.source: 核对曲线和右栏的未应用提示，然后点击 <s id="0">应用编辑</s>。成功后提示编辑已应用，生成按钮恢复可用。
3be922f8707c84b5ad65048c8905171eb13bcd5b.translation: Inspect curves and the unapplied-edit message on the right, then click <s id="0">Apply edits</s>. Success marks edits applied and enables generation again.

0443ef623c87c3e421b023b863aa8bf82d85a8cd.source: 如需保存本次应用轨迹，点击 <s id="0">保存 F0 CSV</s>。文件为完整 1 ms 轨迹，行数通常多于表格控制点数。
0443ef623c87c3e421b023b863aa8bf82d85a8cd.translation: To save the applied tracks, click <s id="0">Save F0 CSV</s>. It contains complete 1 ms tracks, usually more rows than control points.

06ee084311a397e0d13abd3ef2303b6f7b1a3a1f.source: 第一项源 F0 从分析值改为 110 Hz 后，表格和曲线已更新。右栏仍提示未应用修改，需点击应用编辑后才能生成。
06ee084311a397e0d13abd3ef2303b6f7b1a3a1f.translation: After changing the first source F0 to 110 Hz, the table and curve update. The right still reports unapplied changes; Apply edits is required before generation.

8fae34deb583b783bc68b58a88039791472b8a35.source: 源 F0 第一控制点被改为 110 Hz，右栏出现未应用编辑提示，应用编辑可用，生成按钮禁用。
8fae34deb583b783bc68b58a88039791472b8a35.translation: First source F0 control point changed to 110 Hz, unapplied-edit message on the right, Apply edits available, and generation disabled.

5377b999fa924ccc87aed3ae7166ae104151d09d.source: 源和目标 F0 控制点分别填写，改完还需应用修改。
5377b999fa924ccc87aed3ae7166ae104151d09d.translation: Enter source and target F0 controls separately, then apply edits.

8ffce0d7396c90d075a4cd6b0dd7729380ceeaa9.source: <s id="0">修改数值后须点击应用编辑，才会用于生成。</s> 空白按 0 处理，有效正值之间会插值，删空一个单元格不能用来精确插入一段静音。
8ffce0d7396c90d075a4cd6b0dd7729380ceeaa9.translation: <s id="0">After changing values, click Apply edits before they are used for generation.</s> Blanks count as 0; valid positive values are interpolated. Clearing a cell cannot insert a precisely timed silence.

8f4f3004d54e09871394106e53958e220a8dd022.source: <s id="0">应用编辑</s> 更新 F0，继续复用已有声道、残差和脉冲分析。需要更新这些分析时，重新 <s id="1">提取 F0</s>。未修改控制点时可以直接生成。
8f4f3004d54e09871394106e53958e220a8dd022.translation: <s id="0">Apply edits</s> updates F0 while reusing existing vocal-tract, residual, and pulse analyses. To update these, <s id="1">Extract F0</s> again. Without control edits, generation is directly available.

bc07ffb47e2a13d7faeeeb3d5f0eaaca04b4dda5.source: 源 F0 为实线、目标 F0 为虚线，彩色 step 曲线对应所选结果。它们显示当前控制轨迹；选择历史组时，图面改用该组记录。
bc07ffb47e2a13d7faeeeb3d5f0eaaca04b4dda5.translation: Source F0 is solid, target F0 dashed, and colored step curves represent selected results. They show current control tracks; selecting a historical set displays that set's records.

d66d872260767e68ac5ef5d524c4daf5c437f9b7.source: <s id="0">彩色合成 F0 是生成控制轨迹，未从输出 WAV 重新测量。</s> 仅发声类型变化时，各步 F0 可以重合。若要核查实际输出，请另用参数估计等工具测量单步 WAV。
d66d872260767e68ac5ef5d524c4daf5c437f9b7.translation: <s id="0">Colored synthesis F0 curves are generation controls, not remeasurements from output WAVs.</s> F0 steps may overlap in phonation-only continua. Independently measure individual WAVs with Parameter estimation or similar tools to verify actual output.

83689e87f33f4a6bc5c1f83fcd00e39c898a2bb2.source: 在左栏 <s id="0">F0 图窗纵轴</s> 输入下限、上限，只改变显示。下限须为非负数，上限须大于下限；上限留空自动计算，<s id="1">自动范围</s> 恢复下限 0 和自动上限。无效输入会保留最近有效图面并提示，显示范围独立记忆。
83689e87f33f4a6bc5c1f83fcd00e39c898a2bb2.translation: Enter minimum/maximum under <s id="0">F0 plot vertical axis</s> on the left; display only changes. Minimum must be nonnegative and maximum greater. Blank maximum is automatic; <s id="1">Automatic range</s> restores minimum 0 and automatic maximum. Invalid input retains the last valid view and shows a message. Display range is remembered separately.

1d144ac6888c9169c1ec916b65ca74f03d6ac61b.source: 三种连续统的变化对象
1d144ac6888c9169c1ec916b65ca74f03d6ac61b.translation: What the three continuum types change

f7f0745fddfd4c6918ccec7f602793b67fdaa3c9.translation: F0 transitions toward the other endpoint

550950c2ea5e53d9f549b996d495680d5c84f65d.source: 方向源的残差周期形态、声道与时长。
550950c2ea5e53d9f549b996d495680d5c84f65d.translation: Directional source's residual-period shape, vocal tract, and duration.

8727a1f425579620854d85c7e67ccd27e357143c.source: 混合源/目标残差脉冲形态

3f250f962779ec75405af37b1be4349128704e4e.source: 方向源的 F0、声道与时长。
3f250f962779ec75405af37b1be4349128704e4e.translation: Directional source's F0, vocal tract, and duration.

eba75841729effa04234c84506c019b23e98d843.source: F0 与发声类型同时变化

2e7f72d570fe233ada016280ca173f1ee9fae794.translation: Directional source's vocal tract and duration.

5e5138106a4bc7bcfed6099ff4a4371c59f0d2e9.source: <s id="0">合成方向</s> 可选源到目标或目标到源。反向会交换计算角色，时长和声道基础也随之改变，下拉框中的文件角色仍保持原样。请用结果描述核对方向。
5e5138106a4bc7bcfed6099ff4a4371c59f0d2e9.translation: <s id="0">Synthesis direction</s> offers source-to-target or target-to-source. Reversing exchanges computational roles and the duration/vocal-tract basis; file roles in dropdowns remain unchanged. Check direction in result descriptions.

0e4ef5547525ed57350f3533a2371e2840da10d5.source: <s id="0">连续统步数</s> 初始 9，允许 2–50，包含两端。九步中 step01、step05、step09 分别对应 0、0.5、1 的控制比例。两端均经过重合成，比较时请保留原目标音频作为对照。
0e4ef5547525ed57350f3533a2371e2840da10d5.translation: <s id="0">Continuum steps</s> defaults to 9, allows 2–50, and includes both endpoints. In nine steps, step01, step05, and step09 correspond to control ratios 0, 0.5, and 1. Both endpoints are resynthesized; retain original target audio for comparison.

5234b510289f1d2b98342279f48033ae63970831.source: 幅度设置初始为 <s id="0">周期能量匹配</s> 开启、<s id="1">输出幅度匹配源音频</s> 开启、<s id="2">输出峰值限制</s> 0.98。前两项分别匹配残差周期绝对峰值和全段平均绝对振幅；物理能量和主观响度需另行测量。峰值限制须大于 0 且不超过 1，原录音有削波时请先更换材料。
5234b510289f1d2b98342279f48033ae63970831.translation: Amplitude defaults: <s id="0">Period energy matching</s> on, <s id="1">Match output amplitude to source</s> on, and <s id="2">Output peak limit</s> 0.98. The first two match absolute residual-period peaks and full-duration mean absolute amplitude respectively; physical energy and perceived loudness require separate measurement. Peak limit must exceed 0 and not exceed 1. Replace clipped original recordings first.

ffe2451214271ecc18f077fee6cdfcd7f726e030.translation: Generate one set or all six

fb8383bce8e997f6dfd9b46e2dd4809acfc46ef9.source: 初次可选 <s id="0">仅 F0 变化、源到目标、9 步</s>，点击 <s id="1">生成当前</s>。任务进行时显示进度和取消任务，生成按钮暂时禁用。
fb8383bce8e997f6dfd9b46e2dd4809acfc46ef9.translation: Initially choose <s id="0">F0 only, source-to-target, 9 steps</s> and click <s id="1">Generate current</s>. Progress and Cancel task appear while generation buttons are disabled.

37fdf9ce3b07a7372949ae341fc98e6c5b049ca7.source: 需要双向三类结果时，点击 <s id="0">生成全部六组</s>。顺序为正向仅 F0、仅发声类型、同时变化，再反向重复三类。
37fdf9ce3b07a7372949ae341fc98e6c5b049ca7.translation: For bidirectional results of all three types, click <s id="0">Generate all six sets</s>. Order is forward F0-only, phonation-only, both, then the same three in reverse.

5e4b3b68892bd503597339829a0e482ac996ee18.source: 等状态变为完整成功。每个成功组独立出现试听和保存入口，默认载入整组波形，<s id="0">不会自动播放</s>。
5e4b3b68892bd503597339829a0e482ac996ee18.translation: Wait for complete success. Each successful set independently offers listening and saving, loading its full waveform by default, <s id="0">without automatic playback</s>.

4d70a93219a841a29e9963ea9d3344db56ace5d4.source: 九步任务已经提交，右栏显示 0 / 1 组完成并提供取消任务；正在执行时生成按钮禁用，尚无成功结果按钮。
4d70a93219a841a29e9963ea9d3344db56ace5d4.translation: Nine-step task submitted; the right shows 0 / 1 sets complete and Cancel task. Generation is disabled while running, with no successful-result buttons yet.

60563fe3036b1e4fd42753521ca2cfe51a3a4ab9.source: 真实九步生成任务运行中，右栏显示取消任务与 0 / 1 组完成，合成图仍为空。
60563fe3036b1e4fd42753521ca2cfe51a3a4ab9.translation: Actual nine-step task running, with Cancel task and 0 / 1 sets complete on the right, and the synthesis plot empty.

b1cb30f966728d7c768e8a978e12a4360a41521f.source: 源到目标、仅 F0 变化的九步结果已完整成功，整组波形、各步生成控制 F0、任务描述和保存入口可见。
b1cb30f966728d7c768e8a978e12a4360a41521f.translation: Source-to-target F0-only nine-step set fully successful, with concatenated waveform, each step's F0 generation controls, task description, and save controls.

77357e58fa772802ddccf985f8781b8964e04adb.source: 六组共用提交时的步数与幅度设置。每组九步时，共 54 个单步和六个拼接文件。提交后改控件不会改变已生成结果。取消或失败时，已成功组仍保留。
77357e58fa772802ddccf985f8781b8964e04adb.translation: All six sets share submitted step count and amplitude settings. At nine steps each, there are 54 single-step files and six concatenations. Later control edits do not alter generated results. Successful sets remain after cancellation or failure.

bf6aae683e245b702c5f3d0e8a2b97a4d60c2ca1.source: 以下处理后例音来自同一次 <s id="0">仅 F0 变化、源到目标、9 步</s> 任务：50–600 Hz、1 ms、归一化有声时长、21 点。提取后未手改数值，按这 21 点应用编辑；两项幅度匹配开启、峰值限制 0.98，其余高级参数为默认值。
bf6aae683e245b702c5f3d0e8a2b97a4d60c2ca1.translation: The processed examples below come from one <s id="0">F0-only, source-to-target, 9-step</s> task: 50–600 Hz, 1 ms, normalized voiced duration, 21 points. No manual edits followed extraction; those 21 points were applied. Both amplitude matches were enabled, peak limit 0.98, and other advanced parameters default.

7e5b7be17dc08ef15a177f271967fb7a0c906dd2.source: 处理后第 1 步：同组起点，先与前面的原始源音频比较。
7e5b7be17dc08ef15a177f271967fb7a0c906dd2.translation: Processed step 1: starting point of this set; compare first against the original source above.

40d38602554bdf517b0ec7da7f4efcfe8be07230.source: 处理后第 9 步：同组终点，仍使用正向源音频的声道和时长。
40d38602554bdf517b0ec7da7f4efcfe8be07230.translation: Processed step 9: endpoint of the same set, retaining the forward source's vocal tract and duration.

5681d627b388c56bafac87019f2c6ca4e6cce267.source: 先听两端的音高走向，再返回原音作对照。核对末级与目标原音的音质差异；发声类别需结合相关声学指标与听辨检查。
5681d627b388c56bafac87019f2c6ca4e6cce267.translation: Listen to both pitch contours, then return to originals. Check final-step versus original-target voice quality; assess phonation categories with relevant acoustic metrics and listening.

657c26152ba9e9b0475e00ec3726a1ed04e7b8fc.translation: Compare individual steps and the full set

3331743995d9b8e2e2da154c82c96a45ea9a25d9.source: 在右栏历史中选择成功生成任务，核对 <s id="0">方向、类型、步数和任务短 ID</s>。分析、应用或失败条目没有合成组。选择旧组只更换结果图面，左栏当前输入不会自动切回旧材料。
3331743995d9b8e2e2da154c82c96a45ea9a25d9.translation: Select a successful generation task in right-panel history and check <s id="0">direction, type, step count, and short task ID</s>. Analysis, application, or failed entries contain no synthesis set. Selecting an old set changes result views only; current left-panel inputs do not revert.

bde6b52ceacb829c957d3608ad904e5b9ccf63a1.source: 点击 <s id="0">stepXX</s>，立即载入并播放该步全长音频。合成波形及 F0 随之切换，图下当前试听文字显示文件和任务。
bde6b52ceacb829c957d3608ad904e5b9ccf63a1.translation: Click <s id="0">stepXX</s> to load and immediately play that step's full audio. Synthesis waveform and F0 change accordingly; current-listening text below shows file and task.

51fa3a4cf68c86759d0dd21c463c8805716b9ae7.source: 需要只听局部时，在合成波形拖选范围，再用播放条试听。
51fa3a4cf68c86759d0dd21c463c8805716b9ae7.translation: To hear only part, drag a selection in the synthesis waveform and use its playback bar.

2e97303c2ca666b7a9e4781690acfb4a415c201a.source: 点击 <s id="0">整组试听</s>，按 step01 到末级连续播放。F0 图叠加各步曲线并突出当前步骤；曲线横轴按每步独立对齐，合成波形则是拼接时间轴。
2e97303c2ca666b7a9e4781690acfb4a415c201a.translation: Click <s id="0">Play full set</s> for sequential playback from step01 to the last step. The F0 plot overlays all steps and emphasizes the current step. Its time axes align each step independently; the synthesis waveform uses concatenated time.

904f4bd32c8b625d8a927af4d0731bbcee82fb0a.source: 点击 step05 后载入该步的独立波形，F0 图仅加入第五步生成控制曲线；右下当前试听信息标出步骤文件和任务。
904f4bd32c8b625d8a927af4d0731bbcee82fb0a.translation: After clicking step05, its independent waveform loads and only the fifth-step generation-control curve is added to the F0 plot. Current-listening text at lower right names the step file and task.

36310b1ce8659dcadf1ae6d853a213e7bd10a28d.source: 同一九步组选择第五步后的工作台，单步波形、step05 图例和当前试听说明可见。
36310b1ce8659dcadf1ae6d853a213e7bd10a28d.translation: Workbench after selecting the fifth step of the same nine-step set, showing its waveform, step05 legend, and listening description.

303ab052dcc2fe55ac407f76d1115b53f6b9134c.source: 原音、中间步与整组比较
303ab052dcc2fe55ac407f76d1115b53f6b9134c.translation: Compare original, midpoint, and full set

c3d2cd163eb79bb06ba525dafca67cf7beccb500.source: 再听同一任务的第 5 步，它位于控制比例的中点。和原始源音频、前面的两端对照，留意音高走向、边界、异常噪声与级间突变。
c3d2cd163eb79bb06ba525dafca67cf7beccb500.translation: Listen to step 5 of the same task, the midpoint of the control ratio. Compare with the original source and both endpoints above for pitch contour, boundaries, abnormal noise, and abrupt interstep changes.

958f772dd4c5157845cdcb2de70d49d28ff40a3f.source: 原始源音频：与下面同一组第 5 步作近邻对照。
958f772dd4c5157845cdcb2de70d49d28ff40a3f.translation: Original source audio: close comparison with step 5 of the same set below.

86c45767e3bb6fd15d0d7c738be9b717ccfa1e40.source: 处理后第 5 步：同一九步组的中间控制比例。
86c45767e3bb6fd15d0d7c738be9b717ccfa1e40.translation: Processed step 5: middle control ratio of the same nine-step set.

e833384025b32f059df176e4c07f63457ddc1784.source: 最后听九步拼接，观察变化是否连贯。拼接不会自动加入步间静音，正式实验应使用独立 step 文件。
e833384025b32f059df176e4c07f63457ddc1784.translation: Finally listen to the nine-step concatenation for continuity. No interstep silence is automatically added; use independent step files in formal experiments.

3924c682600849d94c638b7351fe7f767cb1c8b9.source: 处理后九步拼接：按第 1 至第 9 步顺序连续试听。
3924c682600849d94c638b7351fe7f767cb1c8b9.translation: Processed nine-step concatenation: continuous playback from step 1 through step 9.

2c696036497c9de633c207213db43eaee8473df1.source: 暂停、停止、播放结束、切换任务或源/目标接管播放时，即时高亮会清除，曲线和结果仍在。正式使用前还需检查单步波形、实际 F0 和所需声学指标，并做小规模预测试。
2c696036497c9de633c207213db43eaee8473df1.translation: Pausing, stopping, reaching playback end, switching tasks, or source/target taking over playback clears live highlighting while curves and results remain. Before formal use, inspect individual waveforms, actual F0, and required acoustic metrics, and conduct a small pilot.

9ab617cb4f2b0a9717d244099cfb278ffd58209d.source: 同组按步骤顺序拼接的试听文件。
9ab617cb4f2b0a9717d244099cfb278ffd58209d.translation: Listening file concatenating the same set in step order.

a29e31cba9934d2e60fd05ed4279674d8cc34a8c.source: time_ms、source_f0、target_f0，完整 1 ms 源/目标控制轨迹；0 表示无有效值。
a29e31cba9934d2e60fd05ed4279674d8cc34a8c.translation: time_ms, source_f0, target_f0: complete 1 ms source/target control tracks; 0 means no valid value.

8ad75b5c05b1d6cc4a0dee2ee288fa132ef8d6a7.source: 输入身份、参数、对齐、控制点、算法/运行时版本及输出清单。
8ad75b5c05b1d6cc4a0dee2ee288fa132ef8d6a7.translation: Input identities, parameters, alignment, control points, algorithm/runtime versions, and output manifest.

01a45b42266cf7f7f7ff1f9e5d1be8eaae7e2f04.source: 另行导出的当前 F0 图，300 dpi。
01a45b42266cf7f7f7ff1f9e5d1be8eaae7e2f04.translation: Separately exported current F0 plot at 300 dpi.

8cb62f222ff015dce6603889c49b696437684dfe.source: 选择成功组，点击 <s id="0">保存完整组</s>。桌面未选输出位置时会先请求选择目录，结果保存在其内的 任务结果 子目录。已有不同内容文件采用保护名称。
8cb62f222ff015dce6603889c49b696437684dfe.translation: Select a successful set and click <s id="0">Save complete set</s>. On desktop, if no output location is selected, a directory is requested first. Results go in its 任务结果 subdirectory; different existing content receives protected names.

fc2de03a2e564802a39b8955733cb4c785fcbc2b.source: 网页点击 <s id="0">下载完整组</s>，得到 完整组 ZIP 包。解压后检查所有单步、拼接 WAV、CSV 和 JSON。
fc2de03a2e564802a39b8955733cb4c785fcbc2b.translation: On the web, click <s id="0">Download complete set</s> for a complete-set ZIP. Extract and inspect every step, concatenated WAV, CSV, and JSON.

2c7c743d3f891eeea33e239ab87396422138100b.source: 保存失败时检查目录是否可访问、空间和写入权限，再保存同一成功组。取消目录选择只退出此次保存。
2c7c743d3f891eeea33e239ab87396422138100b.translation: On save failure, check directory access, space, and write permissions, then save the same successful set again. Cancelling directory selection only exits this save attempt.

a4290f211d7912af5bb42afb389e7bd08604f208.source: 完整九步组保存成功后，右栏显示已保存本组完整文件和参数清单，顶部显示所选输出位置；F0 图像仍需另行导出。
a4290f211d7912af5bb42afb389e7bd08604f208.translation: After saving the full nine-step set, the right confirms complete files and parameter manifest saved, while the top shows the output location. Export the F0 image separately.

23ca9509e400b85908fa7610cb512c5cd2464e7a.source: 保存完整九步组成功的工作台，顶部输出位置和右栏保存成功提示可见。
23ca9509e400b85908fa7610cb512c5cd2464e7a.translation: Workbench after successfully saving the complete nine-step set, with output location at the top and save success on the right.

d6e1320ee1f2d9116372acba594d33cf229f4890.source: <s id="0">选中 step05 试听后，保存完整组仍会保存全部步骤。</s> 需要单个 WAV 时，从已保存的组目录取出对应文件。
d6e1320ee1f2d9116372acba594d33cf229f4890.translation: <s id="0">Even after selecting step05 for listening, Save complete set still saves every step.</s> For one WAV, take the corresponding file from the saved set directory.

c56253fb76724d280ae919ff87a166769c37f27e.source: 再保存 F0 图与单独文件
c56253fb76724d280ae919ff87a166769c37f27e.translation: Save the F0 figure and separate files

fb4c2703cc15c94de444007dd6f1a8866d610bcc.source: 选回需要的历史组和单步/整组，调整左栏纵轴。
fb4c2703cc15c94de444007dd6f1a8866d610bcc.translation: Return to the desired historical set and step/full set, then adjust the left-panel vertical axis.

ed741a0464c3acb13f838d1d2546006c04cf4321.source: 点击 F0 图右上 <s id="0">导出图片</s>。PNG 保留点击时的轴、曲线与完整图例，超出范围的曲线裁剪在图框内，瞬时播放高亮不写入图片。
ed741a0464c3acb13f838d1d2546006c04cf4321.translation: Click <s id="0">Export image</s> at the F0 plot's upper right. PNG retains axes, curves, and the full legend at that moment. Out-of-range curves are clipped inside the frame; transient playback highlighting is omitted.

cadcc1e44a593513f51420352a7982b5c28fee6e.source: 核对图像的任务、轴单位及 step 图例，把图片同组文件一起保存。PNG 不自动包含在完整组中。
cadcc1e44a593513f51420352a7982b5c28fee6e.translation: Check task, axis units, and step legends, and keep the image with its set files. PNG is not automatically included in the complete set.

aeeff33e0561c8a69f70002caed5a3fdba92a6a2.source: <s id="0">保存 F0 CSV</s> 导出左栏当前已应用轨迹，<s id="1">参数与结果清单</s> 导出所选组 JSON，<s id="2">导出图片</s> 保存当前图面。保存旧组时，优先保留该组目录内 CSV，避免混入后来分析的文件。CSV 与 JSON 当前没有导入入口。
aeeff33e0561c8a69f70002caed5a3fdba92a6a2.translation: <s id="0">Save F0 CSV</s> exports currently applied left-panel tracks; <s id="1">Parameter and result manifest</s> exports selected-set JSON; <s id="2">Export image</s> saves the current view. Prefer the CSV in an old set's directory when saving it, avoiding later-analyzed files. CSV and JSON have no import function currently.

b9519b67141ef87b0b561111e6171a58863b6442.source: 点击 <s id="0">刷新任务历史</s> 找回成功组。其试听、曲线和保存都使用该组记录，后来改变输入或参数不会改写旧组。可下载参数与结果清单，核对旧组输入和版本。
b9519b67141ef87b0b561111e6171a58863b6442.translation: Click <s id="0">Refresh task history</s> to recover successful sets. Listening, curves, and saving use each set's records; later input or parameter changes do not rewrite old sets. Download the parameter/result manifest to check inputs and versions.

bb98e77021d141ef265ea64c13ce3822285dba2d.source: 需要稍后继续编辑时，点击顶部 <s id="0">保存参数草稿</s>。任务进行中先等待完成或取消。草稿会保留参数和未应用控制点。
bb98e77021d141ef265ea64c13ce3822285dba2d.translation: To continue editing later, click <s id="0">Save parameter draft</s> at the top. Wait for completion or cancellation of running tasks first. Drafts retain parameters and unapplied control points.

f425d51a7eef6dc36e667a27d893799827de3dda.source: 重开后重新选择目录和输入，再 <s id="0">提取 F0</s>。只有文件内容、分析设置、点数和对齐均匹配时，才恢复草稿控制点。
f425d51a7eef6dc36e667a27d893799827de3dda.translation: After reopening, reselect the directory and inputs, then <s id="0">Extract F0</s>. Draft controls restore only when file content, analysis settings, point count, and alignment all match.

7652ace5661ca1460098f8c1975cc5c23bb9894d.source: 恢复控制点后仍点击 <s id="0">应用编辑</s>，再生成。草稿不保存长期目录授权。
7652ace5661ca1460098f8c1975cc5c23bb9894d.translation: After restoration, still click <s id="0">Apply edits</s> before generating. Drafts do not retain long-term directory permissions.

94d5d94c22bc55e50088fbe72e20008ce7fa3e18.source: <s id="0">提取 F0</s> 禁用：确认两份文件均已选择、波形读取成功，没有正在执行的任务。
94d5d94c22bc55e50088fbe72e20008ce7fa3e18.translation: <s id="0">Extract F0</s> disabled: check both files are selected, waveforms loaded, and no task running.

0381d81972f99a24d23cdeb5de812242547dd101.source: 提示 <s id="0">原分析失效</s>：材料或分析参数改变，重新提取 F0。
0381d81972f99a24d23cdeb5de812242547dd101.translation: <s id="0">Original analysis invalid</s>: materials or analysis parameters changed; reextract F0.

7ca126d35ff9a5f599369714eb559ab610765fa5.source: 提示 <s id="0">未应用修改</s>：核对控制表后应用编辑。此时保存 F0 CSV 也暂不可用，旧成功组仍可保存。
7ca126d35ff9a5f599369714eb559ab610765fa5.translation: <s id="0">Unapplied changes</s>: inspect the control table and apply edits. Save F0 CSV is also temporarily unavailable; old successful sets remain savable.

95963e8cd992888712090c625599910b2f6d75d7.source: 超过输入预算 / 音频损坏

fb0653c53e7fa9b10e8475c5d26e55fa45ed8870.source: 检查时长、帧数、文件大小和 WAV 可读性，另存合适短材料后刷新、重选。
fb0653c53e7fa9b10e8475c5d26e55fa45ed8870.translation: Check duration, frames, file size, and WAV readability. Save suitable short material, then refresh and reselect.

90a8f5f4d40bf665009cb59ed97370d9c2ae0cf3.source: 没有有效有声区 / F0 分析失败
90a8f5f4d40bf665009cb59ed97370d9c2ae0cf3.translation: No valid voiced region / F0 analysis failure

b5e46b12784345d66ab24b6c15acb25696591b30.source: 先听原材料，再调整 F0 范围并重新分析。不要仅凭失败判定材料无发声。
b5e46b12784345d66ab24b6c15acb25696591b30.translation: Listen to originals, adjust F0 range, and reanalyze. Failure alone does not show that no phonation exists.

3b8acd459726683ee2d77bd9e01fc369ffe3fb02.source: 检查负峰阈值和脉冲内/外窗，从默认值逐项尝试，每次重提取。
3b8acd459726683ee2d77bd9e01fc369ffe3fb02.translation: Check negative-peak threshold and pulse inner/outer windows. Try one change at a time from defaults, reextracting each time.

f0af46c6f34a2da0841402055bc5429164111bc5.source: 可手动选择 Parselmouth 并重新分析，记录提取方法的改变。
f0af46c6f34a2da0841402055bc5429164111bc5.translation: Manually select Parselmouth and reanalyze; record the extraction-method change.

8b8823f91cbb54226716514693675cf59cb3da93.source: 使用有限数值、每轨至少一个正值，核对帧长/帧移/阶数及内外窗关系。
8b8823f91cbb54226716514693675cf59cb3da93.translation: Use finite values with at least one positive per track. Check frame length/shift/order and inner/outer window relationships.

ff5b0073835f81d2994107ab5063f99892659f37.source: 合成 F0 读取失败 / 入口未提供曲线
ff5b0073835f81d2994107ab5063f99892659f37.translation: Synthesis F0 loading failed / curves unavailable in this interface

b51f0a8cb02b9ebaf062c09975d3601b9a91fa82.source: 刷新并重选完整成功组。仍可保存有效 WAV 到外部核查。
b51f0a8cb02b9ebaf062c09975d3601b9a91fa82.translation: Refresh and reselect a fully successful set. Valid WAVs can still be saved for external verification.

3c2d4fcc0f72251e3e11fd548b1e0e7192b8712c.source: 点击 <s id="0">取消任务</s>，或历史行的 <s id="1">取消此任务</s>，等待状态结束。核对已完成组数，刷新历史并保存成功组。未完整成功的组和后续未提交组不会自动补算。
3c2d4fcc0f72251e3e11fd548b1e0e7192b8712c.translation: Click <s id="0">Cancel task</s> or <s id="1">Cancel this task</s> in a history row, and wait for the status to finish. Check completed-set count, refresh history, and save successful sets. Incomplete sets and later unsubmitted sets are not automatically completed.

9c6a70bb63dd2fc145325a4296c53a5c41c55b92.source: 失败、取消或中断条目可点击 <s id="0">重试</s>，再刷新查看。重试沿用该任务原输入与参数。要使用新参数，请重新分析/应用后生成；再次生成全部六组会建立新批次。
9c6a70bb63dd2fc145325a4296c53a5c41c55b92.translation: Failed, cancelled, or interrupted entries offer <s id="0">Retry</s>; refresh afterward. Retry uses the task's original inputs and parameters. For new parameters, reanalyze/apply and generate anew. Generate all six again creates a new batch.

1ddbb95b58435b4a1cb2cdf28c2095b9ee21463d.source: 结果缺失或读取失败时，刷新任务历史后重新读取；仍缺失时重新生成完整组。网页权限、额度或有效期变化时，核对项目资源状态；仍有效的成功组可继续保存。单独下载 CSV、JSON、PNG 后，也请确认实际下载位置和完成状态。
1ddbb95b58435b4a1cb2cdf28c2095b9ee21463d.translation: If results are missing or fail to load, refresh history and reload; regenerate the complete set if still missing. For changed web permissions, quotas, or expiration, inspect project resources. Still-valid successful sets remain savable. After separate CSV/JSON/PNG downloads, confirm actual locations and completion.

3253645b4a593b25b29d1c0ad212b92db44469df.source: 本模块参考 Lu、Liang、Kong 的载瓦语声调研究及配套重合成代码。经 2026-09-10 作者邮件许可，将相关 MATLAB 代码改写为 Python，并引用、署名和说明改写。代码改写许可与论文、原录音、统计数据的使用范围分别适用。
3253645b4a593b25b29d1c0ad212b92db44469df.translation: This module draws on Lu, Liang, and Kong's Zaiwa tone study and accompanying resynthesis code. With permission by author email on 2026-09-10, the MATLAB code was adapted to Python with citation, attribution, and adaptation notes. Permission to adapt code is separate from use of the paper, original recordings, and statistical data.

cf3fd7ab8c432b7ec14b9eb50af4f7731ae301f4.source: 底栏的 <s id="0">论文</s> 打开出版方页面，<s id="1">原始仓库</s> 提供作者实现，<s id="2">改写说明</s> 介绍本工具适配；<s id="3">方法与引用</s> 可查看来源登记。
cf3fd7ab8c432b7ec14b9eb50af4f7731ae301f4.translation: At the bottom, <s id="0">Paper</s> opens the publisher page, <s id="1">Original repository</s> provides the authors' implementation, <s id="2">Adaptation notes</s> explains this tool's adaptation, and <s id="3">Methods and references</s> shows source registration.

6a11fd547944de2da1baa203be894b6388961417.source: 效果需要结合材料判断

4ac3575b0409b626f16ef7c7cf59290e844b7ea9.source: 本工具增加了 REAPER 嘎裂声 F0 提取、控制点编辑和任务对照等操作。合成效果不理想时，可检查材料、F0、脉冲与声道估计，也可尝试作者团队的官方代码。本工具适配未声明精确复现论文全部流程，其表现应与原方法分别判断。
4ac3575b0409b626f16ef7c7cf59290e844b7ea9.translation: This tool adds REAPER F0 extraction for creaky voice, control editing, and task comparisons. For poor synthesis, check materials, F0, pulses, and vocal-tract estimation, or try the authors' official code. This adaptation does not claim exact reproduction of the paper's full workflow; judge it separately from the original method.

991e5c0d6a0e9504b5a90045000f08441ace2446.source: 本模块用 LPC 残差操纵制作连续统刺激。步数表示控制比例分级，知觉间距和发声类别需通过听辨预测试核对。正式实验前，请保留输入、参数和版本，检查波形、实际 F0 及研究所需指标；涉及声门生理状态时还需相应生理测量。
991e5c0d6a0e9504b5a90045000f08441ace2446.translation: This module manipulates LPC residuals to create continuum stimuli. Steps grade control ratios; perceptual spacing and phonation categories require listening pilots. Retain inputs, parameters, and versions, inspect waveforms, actual F0, and research metrics before formal experiments. Glottal physiological claims require appropriate physiological measurements.
